0.headline: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
0.heading: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
0.intro: The allotment of SFC Environmental Technologies' initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised on October 30, following a 9.47 times subscription to the Rs 667.53-crore issue.
0.body:
The allotment of SFC Environmental Technologies' initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised on October 30, following a 9.47 times subscription to the Rs 667.53-crore issue. Investors can check their allotment status through the registrar, MUFG Intime India, or the stock exchanges once the basis of allotment is published.

The IPO received bids for 13,41,12,240 shares against 1,41,59,744 shares on offer by the close of bidding on October 29, according to NSE data.

Qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) led the demand, subscribing to their reserved portion 18.81 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) category was subscribed 12.81 times, while the retail investor portion received bids for 2.71 times the shares reserved for it.

Read Also: BLS Polymers IPO allotment today; GMP at 45% — check status on BSE, NSE and registrar

In the grey market, SFC Environmental Technologies shares were commanding a premium of around 6 percent on the morning of October 30, according to InvestorGain. The grey market premium (GMP) is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee listing gains. It can fluctuate before the stock market debut.

SFC Environmental Technologies IPO allotment status: How to check

Check allotment status on MUFG Intime India

Step 1. Visit the MUFG Intime India IPO allotment page at https://in.mpms.mufg.com/Initial_Offer/public-issues.html
Step 1. Select SFC Environmental Technologies from the list of issues, once available.
Step 1. Choose an identification option, such as PAN or application number.
Step 1. Enter the required details and submit.
Step 1. Your allotment status will appear on the screen once the results are published.

Check allotment status on BSE

Step 1. Visit the BSE IPO application status page at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check
Step 1. Select 'Equity' as the issue type.
Step 1. Choose SFC Environmental Technologies from the issue list.
Step 1. Enter your application number or PAN, as requested.
Step 1. Submit the details to view your allotment status.

Check IPO bid details on NSE

Step 1. Visit the NSE IPO bid verification page at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 1. Follow the instructions to verify your IPO bid.
Step 1. Select the relevant issue and enter the required application details.
Step 1. Your allotment status will appear on the screen once the results are published.

The IPO opened for subscription on October 27 and closed on October 29. The company fixed the price band at Rs 313 to Rs 330 per share, valuing it at approximately Rs 3,232.5 crore at the upper end of the band.

The minimum lot size was 45 shares, translating into an investment of Rs 14,850 at the upper price of Rs 330 per share.

The Rs 667.53-crore issue comprises a fresh issue of Rs 150 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of approximately 1.56 crore equity shares worth Rs 517.53 crore.

Check IPO News Here

The proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, while the OFS proceeds will be received by the selling shareholders.

SFC Environmental Technologies plans to use Rs 42.23 crore from the fresh issue proceeds to repay or prepay certain borrowings taken by the company and its wholly owned subsidiary, Vasudha Waste Treatment Private Limited. Another Rs 74.92 crore has been earmarked for working capital requirements, with the balance intended for general corporate purposes.

The basis of allotment is expected on October 30. Refunds for unsuccessful applicants and credit of allotted shares to demat accounts are scheduled for November 2, ahead of the November 3 listing.

IIFL Capital Services, JM Financial and Nuvama Wealth Management are the book-running lead managers to the issue.

About SFC Environmental Technologies

Incorporated in 2005, SFC Environmental Technologies provides engineering solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, and solid waste treatment.

The company's operations focus on technologies used to manage wastewater and solid waste across municipal and industrial applications. Its solutions address treatment, recycling and reuse requirements, supporting infrastructure projects related to water and waste management.

1.headline: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO booked 2x so far on Day 3; check latest GMP
1.heading: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO booked 2x so far on Day 3; check latest GMP
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of M K Sons Fine Jewels continued to draw strong investor interest on the last day of bidding, with the issue receiving 1.86 times subscription by 11:20 am on October 30, according to NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of M K Sons Fine Jewels saw a pick-up in demand on the last day of bidding, with the issue receiving 1.86 times subscription by 11:20 am on October 30, according to NSE data.

The Rs 275.4-crore IPO received bids for 2,21,18,915 shares against 1,19,00,000 shares on offer. The non-institutional investors led the demand with 4.09 times subscription, followed by retail investors with 1.4 times subscription.

In the grey market, M K Sons Fine Jewels shares commanded 8 percent premium on the morning of October 30, as per InvestorGain. The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards a public issue before its listing. However, it does not guarantee listing gains, and the premium can fluctuate depending on market conditions and investor demand.

Read Also: BLS Polymers IPO allotment today; GMP at 45% — check status on BSE, NSE and registrar

The company has fixed the price band for the IPO at Rs 153-162 per share, valuing the company at around Rs 912 crore at the upper end of the band.

The bidding will close today, on October 30. The share allotment is expected to be finalised by November 2, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on November 4.

The IPO comprises 1.7 crore equity shares, including a fresh issue of 1.36 crore shares worth Rs 220.32 crore at the upper end of the price band. The remaining portion of the issue comprises an offer for sale (OFS).

The company plans to use the proceeds from the fresh issue primarily to expand its retail footprint and reduce debt.

Of the net proceeds, Rs 152.8 crore will be allocated towards setting up a new showroom in Maharashtra and expanding an existing showroom in Gujarat. Another Rs 30 crore will be used to repay debt, while the remaining amount will be utilised for general corporate purposes.

On the financial side, the company reported revenue of Rs 538.7 crore for the financial year ended March 2026, marking a 53.4 percent increase from Rs 351.3 crore in the previous financial year. Its profit more than doubled to Rs 51.8 crore in FY26 from Rs 23.3 crore a year earlier.

Check IPO News Here

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported a profit of Rs 15 crore on revenue of Rs 101.4 crore.

Aryaman Financial Services has been appointed as the merchant banker for the issue.

About M K Sons Fine Jewels

M K Sons Fine Jewels is a Mumbai-based jewellery retailer that sells gold, diamond and cubic zirconia (CZ) jewellery through its own retail showrooms.

The company currently operates five showrooms, including three in Mumbai and two in Ahmedabad. The proposed expansion is expected to support its plans to increase its retail presence.

2.headline: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO subscribed 3x so far on Day 2; QIBs, retail investors lead demand
2.heading: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO subscribed 3x so far on Day 2; QIBs, retail investors lead demand
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Bombay Coated & Special Steels remained in demand on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 3 times subscription by 10:50 am on October 30, as per NSE data.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels remained in demand on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 3 times subscription by 10:50 am on October 30, as per NSE data.

The Rs 183.06 crore IPO received bids for 4,95,42,402 shares against 1,65,33,012 shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers led the demand with 6.55 times subscription, followed by retail investors with 1.78 times subscription.

In the grey market, Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels shares were commanding a premium of 10 percent on the morning of October 30, according to InvestorGain. However, the GMP is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee the listing price or returns.

Read Also: From selling paan to Rs 1,000-crore biryani business: How Nagasamy Naidu built Tamil Nadu's popular 'Dindigul Thalappakatti Biriyani'

The company has fixed the price band for the issue at Rs 78-82 per share. Investors can apply for a minimum of 182 shares in one lot, requiring an investment of Rs 14,924 at the upper end of the price band.

The IPO will remain open for bidding until November 2. The tentative listing date for Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels shares on the BSE and NSE is November 5.

The IPO comprises an entirely fresh issue of shares worth Rs 183.06 crore. The company plans to utilise a substantial portion of the proceeds to reduce its debt and meet costs associated with capital equipment.

Of the net proceeds, Rs 125 crore will be used to repay or prepay certain borrowings. Another Rs 15.77 crore has been earmarked for costs related to acquiring capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels reported an improvement in its revenue and profit in fiscal 2026. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,266.82 crore in FY26 from Rs 1,055.71 crore in FY25. The company had reported revenue of Rs 755.26 crore in FY24.

Profit after tax (PAT) increased to Rs 30.54 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 28.67 crore in FY25 and Rs 21.14 crore in FY24.

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of Rs 397.08 crore and a profit after tax of Rs 15.08 crore.

About Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels

Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels is a steel processing company that converts steel coils into processed steel products through operations such as slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing.

The company's manufacturing facilities are located in Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh.

It caters to industrial customers that require processed steel for their operations. As of June 30, 2026, the company had an aggregate installed processing capacity of 1,23,153 tonnes per annum.
